'''Corrosion''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the mod. This Effect will deal damage to your armor over time, similar to the Poison effect, but for your armor durability instead. 3 damage per potency will be dealt to each armor item's durability per second, while you have this effect. The higher the potency, the higher the damage.

Corrosion cannot be removed by drinking Milk.
